description: This file defines functions and data for hexadecimal value conversion, including a lookup table and functions for converting hex characters to values and bytes.

methods.name: unsigned int hexval(unsigned char c)
methods.description: Returns the numerical value of a hexadecimal digit using a lookup table.

methods.name: int hex2chr(const char * s)
methods.description: Converts two hexadecimal characters into a single byte, with error detection.

methods.name: hex_to_bytes
methods.description: Converts a string of hexadecimal digits into binary data, returning 0 on success or -1 on error.

ctags.name: hexval
ctags.pattern: /^static inline unsigned int hexval(unsigned char c)$/
